description: Source code for a Zephyr shell command module to interact with battery-backed RAM (BBRAM), including functions for parsing input, reading, writing, and command registration.

methods.name: parse_ul
methods.description: Parses an unsigned long from a string, returns -EINVAL on failure.

methods.name: parse_u32
methods.description: Parses a uint32_t from a string, returns -EINVAL on failure.

methods.name: parse_u8
methods.description: Parses a uint8_t from a string, returns -EINVAL on failure.

methods.name: parse_device
methods.description: Retrieves BBRAM device binding based on command-line argument.

methods.name: cmd_read
methods.description: Handles the 'read' command to read data from BBRAM.

methods.name: cmd_write
methods.description: Handles the 'write' command to write data to BBRAM.

methods.name: device_name_get
methods.description: Provides device name for shell command completion.

methods.name: cmd_bbram
methods.description: Default handler for unknown BBRAM commands.
